leadText:
(Japanese: ロブ Lob) is a character of the day who appeared in A Festival Reunion!.

Lob was among the s competing in the World Coronation Series Battle Festival Challenge in Shalour City. He had a battle against , where he used his against . Although Lob had a good strategy against Pokémon, Ash was able to win, causing Lob's rank to go down.

Lob was later seen watching Ash's battle against .
